expected_symptom: At -O1 the PIX pass -dxil-dbg-value-to-dbg-declare is handed a pointer-typed llvm.dbg.value for a local and drops the variable, emitting no llvm.dbg.declare for it, so PixTest::PixStructAnnotation_* fail.
history: Fixed between v1.6.2112 (2021-12-08) and v1.7.2207 (2022-07-18). DO NOT READ THE BISECT LINE AS SYMPTOM HISTORY: it reports "regressed-in v1.6.2104" because match.json tests only the PRECONDITION (that -O1 emits a pointer-typed llvm.dbg.value), which dxc first did for this shader in v1.6.2104. dxc.exe cannot run the PIX pass the bug is in, and the fix changed nothing dxc.exe outputs, so no predicate over dxc output can see this transition. The real history comes from manual-case-release-history.txt, which drives each release's own dxcompiler.dll IDxcOptimizer via dxopt -external: at -O1 the pass emits 0 llvm.dbg.declare on v1.6.2104, v1.6.2106 and v1.6.2112, and 2 on all 15 releases from v1.7.2207 to v1.9.2607 plus main-debug. v1.4.1907 is invalid evidence (rejects as_6_5) and so is v1.5.2010 (compiles fine but emits no DILocalVariable or llvm.dbg.* record for the local at any -O level, so the pass has no input) -- their -Od control rows are what establish that. Fix attributed to c0676c7ca (PR #4375), confirmed in v1.7.2207 and absent from v1.6.2112 by git merge-base; the window holds 248 commits, 3 touching DxilDbgValueToDbgDeclare.cpp, so attribution is strong, not proven.
reviewed_by: gpt-5.6-sol (blind reproducibility check, SKILL.md step "Test reproducibility"; and independent draft review, SKILL.md step 10, applied selectively at collation)
summary: Does not reproduce on main (13730886e). Fixed between v1.6.2112 and v1.7.2207; the evidence points to c0676c7ca (PR #4375, Apr 2022), which stopped DxilDbgValueToDbgDeclare unconditionally early-returning on pointer-typed llvm.dbg.value. Measured by running each release's own -dxil-dbg-value-to-dbg-declare over PixStructAnnotation_FloatN's shader via dxopt -external: at -O1 the pass emits 0 llvm.dbg.declare on v1.6.2104/2106/2112 and 2 on v1.7.2207 through main. The reporter's own repro now passes 18/18, and the same commit deleted the three "don't run -O1 test until pointer types are dealt with" opt-outs from PixTest.cpp. Attribution is strong but window-bounded and not proven: 248 commits, 3 of them touching the pass, none built in isolation. NOTE: cmd.txt and the bisect line measure only the precondition, not the symptom - dxc.exe cannot run PIX passes.
text_stale: The body's repro instruction can no longer be followed: it says to open PixTest.cpp, change -Od to -O1 in Compile, and run PixTest::PixStructAnnotation_*. That edit is already upstream -- OptimizationChoices[] = {{L"-Od", false}, {L"-O1", true}} runs both levels for every case, and commit c0676c7ca deleted all three "break; // don't run -O1 test until pointer types are dealt with by value-to-declare pass" opt-outs. A reader following the body today finds nothing to change and a suite that passes. Also standing unanswered: @damyanp asked on 2024-06-27 "is this something we still need to track?" -- the measured answer is no, it was fixed in April 2022.
title: value-to-declare pass not handling pointer case under -O1
